scope: Development crops from the original v1 routine and v1 primary cohorts (already used for calibration). Not test evidence.

problems: 9/39 outputs omit the forklift key (all on shelf/rack crops) -> parse error under unchanged parse rules
7/17 parsed shelf/rack crops answered forklift=yes (R03, R08, R09)
descriptions mention a forklift on crops answered forklift=no
decision.revision: one prompt-only revision look-v3: require all three keys; define forklift and exclude racks/shelves/pallets/boxes/carts; do not mention a forklift in the description if none. Crop logic, model, decoding and parse rules unchanged.
decision.decision_rule: Keep look-v3 only if its exact-match count (both fields parsed and equal to the visual label, parse errors count as misses) over the same 39 dev crops is greater than 23 AND it confirms at least 15/17 true-forklift crops; otherwise restore look-v2.
decision.correction: look_v2_dev.shelf_rack_flagged should read 6/22 (22 shelf/rack crops: 13 parsed, 9 parse errors), not 6/26; noted after the v3 run, criteria unaffected.

look_v3_dev.notes: 4 overhead reach trucks answered forklift=no; 1 person=no on a visible person; 2 outputs with person='standing' (parse errors)

outcome.reason: look-v3 exact matches 32 > 23 but true-forklift confirmation 11/17 < 15/17, so the pre-set rule restores look-v2. scripts/look_local.py restored byte-identical to the original (sha256 019cd2f1...).
